annotations.text:
Copper now appears as material, not only as ink.

A 5px masthead band, filled section markers, a solid tag on the leading recipe, filled tick boxes, copper-led split rules, filled primary buttons, and 4px coverage bars. Ink-only copper is what made the first pass feel empty.

Freshness is a filled marker while it is urgent and an outline once it is not.

Rust #a83e28 → amber #c78a2e → wheat #e0c08a → outline. The words carry the meaning too, so colour is never the only signal.

Still one filled block per page.

Copper marks what matters — the leading recipe, the primary action, the section you are in. If everything were copper the accent would stop meaning anything, which is the failure mode on the other side of monotone.

This replaces the dark stone-950 / lime-400 theme in the scaffold.

src/styles.css and the shell in App.tsx both change — nav becomes text links with a copper underline rather than filled pills. Cheap while the routes are still empty.

The select on this board is live — click it.

Every menu in the app animates opacity and transform only, 140ms in on ease-out, 90ms out. Nothing that triggers layout: no height, no top, no box-shadow transitions. Build it on the native popover API so dismissal, stacking and focus return come free.

Build components/ui/ before the feature work.

Select, quantity+unit, text field, date, buttons, freshness marker, tick box, filter row, coverage bar, row actions, confirmation note, empty state, section heading. Skip this and the same select gets written four times with four different behaviours.
